[EN] I was scouting the southern end of the lake and spotted some ludicrously dressed {@LinkCreature:23#11#malicious jesters} helping some {@LinkCreature:23#12#kobold mercenaries}.

This is not an alliance we can allow. Put an end to it—and them.
[ES] Estaba explorando el extremo sur del lago y vi a unos {@LinkCreature:23#11#malicious jesters} ridículamente vestidos ayudando a unos {@LinkCreature:23#12#kobold mercenaries}.

Esta no es una alianza que podamos permitir. Ponle fin a esto, y a ellos.

[EN] Fighting kobolds is one thing—fighting those jesters is another. I hate those things.

Thank you. We would have lost a lot of soldiers if you hadn't handled this.
[ES] Luchar contra kobolds es una cosa, luchar contra esos bufones es otra. ¡Odio esas cosas!

Gracias. Habríamos perdido a muchos soldados si no te hubieras encargados de esto.
